headline: Japan's Inflation Accelerates to 2.2% in October
summary: Japan's inflation rate rose to 2.2% in October. The Bank of Japan said last month that inflation had reached its 2% target and was expected to stay clearly above it.
why: The Bank of Japan sets monetary policy for Japan, and inflation readings shape expectations for interest rate decisions that affect the yen and Japanese government bond yields.
original_headline: La inflación de Japón se acelera al 2.2% en octubre
